2. Back to your device, press Home key and enter Settings->General->Keyboard->Keyboards->Add New Keyboard->Select UrKeyboard.
3. Click on UrKeyboard under keyboards, and enable the "Allow Full Access"(need to access your own dictionary file).
4. Press Home Key to back to home, find UrKeyboard App, click to open it, and select your cin file to import it.
5. To test your input method at test area, if everything is fine, here you are, Your Keyboard(UrKeyboard) is ready for you.
